summary: Smile Spa has strong proof: a 4.8 Google rating from 184 reviews and real veneer cases. The page does not turn that proof into booked appointments yet.

findings.problem: The only form asks for name, phone and message, with no date, time or treatment. Booking buttons go to anchors on the same page.
findings.cost: A patient ready to book still has to wait for a callback, and many will choose a clinic with instant booking.
findings.fix: A booking form with treatment, date and time, plus a confirmation message.

findings.problem: The service headings (Dental Implants, Cosmetic Dentistry, Orthodontic Braces) have no descriptions, prices or links, and everything sits on one long page.
findings.cost: Patients searching for a specific treatment land on a page that does not answer them, and you rank for none of them.
findings.fix: One page per treatment, written to rank for searches like veneers Dubai.

findings.problem: Typos and garbled copy: dental toursim, crowns,bridges, Polyclinic dubai, and a doctor bio that reads Dr Mahaini conferences speaker as Certified Speaker for Absoanchor.
findings.cost: Errors in a clinical page make patients doubt the care that goes into the treatment.
findings.fix: A proofread build with clear doctor profiles.

findings.problem: Several links go to # (the Services menu, doctor cards and the footer), and no email address is shown anywhere.
findings.cost: Dead links lose visitors, and patients who prefer email have no way to reach you.
findings.fix: Working links everywhere and a visible contact email.

redesign: A proof first homepage that puts your 4.8 rating and veneer cases beside every booking button.
Real online booking with date and time, plus WhatsApp, so a patient books in under 30 seconds.
A page per treatment and per doctor, written to rank in search and answer what patients ask.
